_readme: Every <...> is a question the agent asks the operator, one at a time. Paths may be relative to the repo root.

reference.controlm_json: <the reference branch's FE folder JSON, e.g. ../cib-boxfin-t1mdslbfe/projects/cib-boxfin-t1mdslbfe.json>
reference.display: <how the reference branch appears in job descriptions, e.g. SLB>
reference.books_csv: <J-R3b: the reference books' CODE + DESCRIPTION, e.g. runs/<BRANCH>/<env>/fe-jobs/01-evidence/J-R3b-reference-books.csv>
reference.template_book: <optional - the reference book whose chain is copied, e.g. 15, or {instrument: book}; empty = the first one>
controlm_other: <optional - more Control-M folder repos / JSONs to find who emits an external event: the reference branch's ACC folder repo, GBO / shared folders>
dml_repos: <optional - cib-boxfin-dbboxfe and cib-boxacc-dbboxacc checkouts: group names in pending-questions.md>
reference.mbj_csv: <optional - J-R2 export (.csv) of the reference branch's MBJ rows: an ACC job's group>
reference.descriptor_dir: <optional - the environment config repo's folder for the reference FE repo (registry env_descriptor_repo), e.g. ../cib-auki-aukicnfgsrvc/cib-boxfin-t1mdslbfe - holds pro.json>

constant_values._comment: optional - CST_ constants -> their values in the reference wrapper package (all_source query): ranks a GBO wait's look-alike by argument, e.g. CST_CURR_PAIR = 0

datalake._comment: optional - the Data Lake (AUKI) Control-M JSONs: a reference book job waiting for its book's Data Lake job becomes, per target book, a wait for that book's own Data Lake job (book label description = book_vr)
reference_json: <the reference branch's Data Lake Control-M JSON>

book_map._comment: optional - target book code -> its book_vr, or DROP

prerequisites._comment: a folder the FE chain waits for (registry prereq_controlm_repos, e.g. the load prices) - remove the entry if the reference has none
prerequisites.folder_name: <ask - the target's folder name for it>
prerequisites.descriptor_dir: <optional - its folder in the environment config repo, if any>

controlm._comment: optional - values that differ from the FE folder's (default: the same, env included)

jobs: <optional - only when no copied job waits for it in a file given: the reference jobs to copy>

instrument: <depos | irs | ccs | cfm | fra | otc | cap | commodities - or a list of them: one run, one set of outputs>

target.env_folder: <optional - the target environment's job confs folder (db.conf / shell.conf + jobs-inventory.csv): its GBO look-alikes>
instruments: <optional - every instrument approved for the target (a wait on another approved instrument's job is suggested as its target name, the others as DROP); empty = this instrument only>

constants._comment: every other CST_ constant the reference lines use -> its name in the target wrapper (J-E4), or SAME

target.instrument_plan: <optional - the run's instrument-plan.csv (default: ../instrument-plan.csv): an instrument `built` / `done` keeps another instrument's waits on it; the others' waits are inherited>
target.dbconf_format: <wrapper (default: the reference line, owner swapped) | pgt_prg (every group line as the core call, T:P, 8 arguments)>
target.branch_pk: <pgt_prg only - the target branch PK (value of the branch constant, J-E4), passed on every line>

constant_values._comment: optional - CST_ constants -> their values in the target wrapper package (all_source query)

target.books_excluded: <optional - default books-excluded.csv beside the books register: books with no BOX job>

controlm.Host: <ask - the DEV host: the folder file is the DEV definition; PRE / PRO hosts go in env>

DocumentationFile._comment: optional - set on every job when given; otherwise the reference's is kept

controlm.host_config_repo: <optional - the repo that applies the host per environment>

env._comment: per environment file of the descriptors: values written into the target's descriptors (Host is never guessed; another property not given keeps the reference's value and is listed to confirm); StartDate = an activation date the reference adds

pro.json.StartDate: <optional - when the reference descriptor adds one>

controlm.target_repo: <the target's FE Control-M repo (registry fe_controlm_repo): PR of projects/<repo>.json after the operator's yes>

renames._comment: old-named reference jobs the chain needs -> the target's new-convention name (the script lists them)

external_events._comment: events the chain waits for that no job of the reference folder emits -> the target's event, KEEP or DROP (pending-questions.md suggests one per event)

initial_accounting._comment: optional - the ACC group the FE chain waits for (one job per instrument, run from db.conf): its db.conf lines are written here and the jobs handed to box-acc-jobs-agent
initial_accounting.name: <e.g. BOX - Initial accounting (PP, Recla, Reval)>

unix.etc_dir: <ask - the folder holding add_new_jobs.ksh; without it the line is OPEN>
unix.reference_unix_dir: <optional - default <reference env_folder>/unix: the reference's delete_jobsBX.ksh / add_new_jobs.ksh>
unix.reference_etc_dir: <optional - default /appl/gm/etc: the etc folder those scripts cd to>
